_comment: Snake locale file. DO NOT translate keys (left side). Only translate values (right side). Keep every {placeholder} exactly as-is. Do NOT translate the move/direction tokens the player types ([up], [down], [left], [right], w, s, a, d) or the ASCII board rendered into {board}.

_slots.{num_players}: Number of players in the match
_slots.{board}: The rendered ASCII grid; keep neutral, never translate its characters
_slots.{groups}: Neutral ranking data (a list of player-id groups, worst to best); do not translate

player_prompt.intro:
{num_players}-Moromu wa Snake holofelong ya {width}×{height}.
O laola moromu {player_id}. Menyetla ya go tsamaya: '[up]'/'[down]'/'[left]'/'[right]' (goba w/s/a/d).
Sepheo: phela nako ye telele kudu goba eba moromu o mokgolo le o fihlelele nomoro ya godimo (moralo wa {max_turns} menyetla).

board.after_moves: Naga ya ga bjale yeo e lego Lekgotleng: {board}

game_action.invalid_death: Noga {player_id} e hwile ka baka la go se šome gabotse.

outcome.survived_win: Sebapadi {player_id} se ile sa phologa; ba bangwe ka moka ba hwile.
outcome.all_dead_simul: Dinoga ka moka di ile tša hwa gatee-tee.
outcome.outlived: Sebapadi se phetše nako e telele go feta ba bangwe ka moka.
outcome.turn_limit: Go fihlelelwa ga mollwane wa go retologa - poelo e kaone kudu ke yona e fenyago papadi ya tie-break.
outcome.ranking: {reason} Tengwa ya kgwele ya morero (e ntle le e betere): {groups}
